verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Lean leaves the δ = 0 slope packed as `taperSlopeFactor d 0`. Unfolding it (the simp step at TerminalStress.lean:888) gives ρ_o·8·g(0), and profileCarrier C d y0 (η, 0) = E_pow(X_b)𝓗(2d/X_b), profileRadius y0 0 = √(2X_b); so the right-hand side of `profileAngularFactor_zero` is exactly 16 ρ_o E_pow(X_b) 𝓗(2d/X_b) g(0)/√(2X_b) — same constant 16, same ρ_o, same √(2X_b), same g(0). The strict inequality is `profileAngularFactor_zero_pos`, for every η in the closed band [-1, 1]; it is proved from positivity of the three factors rather than from the value g(0) = e, which is not stated (see eq-p143-4). The paper's following sentence, a uniform positive lower bound over the closed η-band, is `profile_uniform_cone` (TerminalEdgeFactor.lean:1467), which gives a single m > 0 bounding profileAngularFactor from below on a collar |x| < ε around δ = 0, not only at δ = 0; it is deduced from `profileAngularFactor_zero_pos` by compactness of Icc (-1) 1 (lines 1480-1486) and is used at TerminalEdgePaper.lean:16-20.
